source: Setting a beacon on a nearby location allows Soundscape to keep you informed by playing a sound coming from the direction of that location. This beacon can be muted or unmuted on the home screen. Additionally, Soundscape displays information about the location on the home screen including the distance to it and its street address if it is known.

source: Markers are places that you have saved. They could be places that are discoverable within the app, or they could be entirely new places you have added yourself. You can save your current location as a marker by selecting the *Current Location* button on the home screen and then selecting *Save as Marker*. You can save other locations as a marker by searching for the place you would like to save using the search bar, or finding somewhere using the *Places Nearby* button, both of which can be found on the Soundscape home screen. Once you have found the place you would like, selecting it will take you to the *Location Details* screen. On this screen, select the button called *Save as Marker*.

source: The amount of mobile data used depends on how you use Soundscape. We have designed the app to use only a small amount of data when you’re out and about by doing things like saving points as you walk around so you don’t need to redownload them every time you go back to somewhere you’ve already been. To reduce the amount of mobile data you use, make sure you are connected to Wi-Fi whenever possible, particularly to download the app. When you are not using Soundscape, you should use the *Sleep* button to put Soundscape to sleep or force close the app.

source:
This is a major update to Soundscape.

Travel mode is much improved. When you travel by car or bus, Soundscape now calls out road numbers, your direction of travel, and nearby settlements. It also calls out when you cross rivers, canals, firths, and bays. Please update your offline maps to get these new features. Bus stop descriptions are now much better for users in the UK.

Sleep mode can now wake automatically when it detects that you are moving again. You no longer need to remember to wake it yourself.

We reorganized the underlying code so that we can build an iOS app from the same code. This means that in the future, we can release an iOS app with all of the features we have built for Android.

Please continue to report any problems, however small, through Contact Support in the main menu.
current: Dies ist ein umfangreiches Update für Soundscape. Der Reisemodus wurde deutlich verbessert. Wenn Sie mit dem Auto oder Bus unterwegs sind, sagt Soundscape jetzt Straßennummern, Ihre Fahrtrichtung und nahe gelegene Ortschaften an. Außerdem wird angesagt, wenn Sie Flüsse, Kanäle, Meeresarme und Buchten überqueren. Bitte aktualisieren Sie Ihre Offline‑Karten, um diese neuen Funktionen zu erhalten. Die Beschreibungen von Bushaltestellen sind für Nutzer im Vereinigten Königreich jetzt deutlich besser. Der Ruhemodus kann jetzt automatisch aufwachen, wenn er erkennt, dass Sie sich wieder bewegen. Sie müssen ihn nicht mehr selbst aufwecken. Wir haben den zugrunde liegenden Code umstrukturiert, damit wir aus demselben Code eine iOS‑App erstellen können. Bitte melden Sie weiterhin alle Probleme, egal wie klein, über Support kontaktieren im Hauptmenü.
